{{Top|leg}}
The '''decaleg''' was a type of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] from [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] which were eaten by the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]]. [[Filleted decaleg]]s were a favored Kubaz dish.
